summary: Volunteers take responsibility for precincts the existing party organization has yet to cover.
realLife: Peters coordinated volunteer coverage around the precincts already worked by a local Democratic faction.
gates: A party organization and volunteer operation share territory.
inGame: Campaigns records a volunteer's doors. needs: a precinct coverage map shared by the party and campaign.

turns.what: The party asks volunteers to finish one street inside its assigned precinct.
turns.pulledBy: A regular loses part of an evening to work.
turns.writesBack: The handoff sheet identifies the unfinished street.

turns.what: The two offices discover an uncovered precinct after comparing their lists.
turns.pulledBy: Each roster assumed the other office had claimed it.
turns.writesBack: The next shift gets a new assignment with a named lead.
